- Focused on creating ATS-friendly resumes
- Enhanced with AI to tailor resumes for specific job roles

- A mobile app
- A backend-only system
- A static website

Core goals:
1. Allow users to create resumes from scratch
2. Allow users to upload an existing resume and improve it using AI
3. Generate a new resume based on the job role selected by the user
4. Ensure every resume produced is ATS-friendly
5. Provide multiple resume templates
6. Provide a modern, colorful, professional user interface

- Focus only on app structure and user experience
